title: Example 14-1: Simple Cast of Characters

illustrates.quote: The following format is used for the cast of characters: a. Use a cell-5 heading when a heading is included. b. Use 1-3 margins for the cast of characters, with each name followed on the same line by the character identification. c. Retain font attributes on speaker names; omit font attributes on speaker identifications. d. Follow print punctuation used to separate names from any following identifications. Note: Do not insert punctuation that does not appear in print.

items.text: Baptista Minola, Father of Katherina and Bianca
Katherina (Kate) Minola, The “shrew” of the title

print.notes: No font attributes on any name in this simple cast list (contrast Example 14-2); 'Vincentia' (with a final 'a') is print's own spelling, confirmed against the page image, and matches the braille's own ,v9c5tia1 exactly.
print.printFeatures: A simple 1-3-margin list of characters and their descriptions, plain text, no special font attributes.

braille.notes: 1-3 margins for the cast of characters (14.2.1b); Katherina's own line runs over onto a continuation line beginning in cell 3 ('  title').

resolution: A/B agreed on braille (byte-for-byte) and on print.blocks content; differed only in print.notes/printFeatures wording (A's own note about the 'Vincentia' spelling and its match to the braille kept, since it is independently verified against the page image at pages/page-386.png and is the more substantive observation) and illustrates.quote formatting (line-broken vs space-joined; space-joined kept, matching every other section's own convention).
